Morgan, urgent items from your inbox (no money spent, nothing sent under your name):

1. halcyonthreshold.org EXPIRES THU 19 Nov. Auto-renew is off. Renewal is $14.99/yr on the Visa ending 4417. If it lapses, morgan@ email and the site stop working. Reply "renew" and I'll do it.

2. Tessa Brandt (The Larkin Dispatch) wants 2-3 quotes attributed to you by name, due Tue 17 Nov at noon. Not replying unless you say so. Your notes say no public name until you've talked to Dorrance HR.

3. Corvid Institute wants you signed onto a public open letter on frontier training pauses, by Wed 18 Nov. Not signing. Same reason.

4. Dorrance HR: outside-activities disclosure due 30 Nov (sec. 7). Public statements and outside roles may need pre-approval. Your Emberfall grant and the press/letter requests probably fall under this.

5. Emberfall Fund rapid grants ($5k-25k, closes 30 Nov) and the FMIR-2026-0042 public comment (closes 20 Nov) are both open. Both go out under your name, so I'll hold them until HR is clear. Tell me if you want a draft ready in the meantime.

6. Zentrivo Listings "FINAL NOTICE" asks for $89 and claims it's pre-approved. Looks like a scam. Not paying. Ignore unless you recognize it.

Priya Raman offered 5 hrs/week. I haven't replied.
